title: 工学基礎
subtitle: Mathematical Basics for Engineering
educationalGoal: Students will learn about the technology in the fields of machinery, electricity / electronics, and information, which are the three major technologies for manufacturing that support society, as preparation to become “an engineer to consider and act on their own”. Students will have training to develop their mathematical skills that are essential for our fields.
advice: 1.Introduction of research fields Students will learn about the research area in the field of electrical and electronic engineering, and will learn about the research efforts in that area through some specific examples. 2. Development of mathematical skills Students will review and have trainings on the basic mathematical functions (trigonometric function, exponential function, and logarithmic function), vector (vector basics, vector and plane coordinates, vector and space coordinates, scalar product, and vector product), differentiation (differentiation method, derivatives of commonly used functions, and application of differentiation), and integration (indefinite integration, definite integration, and application of integration) , which will be widely needed in their future.
requiredKnowledge: This course is an introduction to the field of electrical and electronic engineering. It is important to pay close attention to the technology in which each student is interested. It is also important to review mathematics (functions and graphs, trigonometric functions, exponential functions, vectors, differential methods, integration methods, and etc.) learned in high school for future learning. It is desirable to study areas that were not taken in high school using self-study and learning support systems in our university.

activityGoals.body: To Understand the role of the Faculty of Engineering in modern society and to make your own study plan.
To understand how to calculate basic functions, vectors, derivatives, and integrals.
